definitions.explanation: A dining arrangement where customers can serve themselves as much food as they want, typically at a buffet or salad bar.

examples.japanese: サラダバー⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{盛|も}り{放題|ほうだい}です。
ごはん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{盛|も}り{放題|ほうだい}⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's an unlimited rice serving service.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦カレー→カレー：02898_karee⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧さん⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ライス→ライス：08838_raisu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦サラダ→サラダ：01364_sarada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{盛|も}り{放題|ほうだい}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This curry restaurant offers unlimited rice and salad, so it's popular with students.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{盛|も}る→盛る：00292_moru⟧ (to heap, to serve food onto a plate) and ⟦{放題|ほうだい}→放題：03151_houdai⟧ (as much as one likes). The 〜⟦{放題|ほうだい}→放題：03151_houdai⟧ suffix attaches to verb stems to create "all-you-can-X" expressions. This one specifically refers to food you serve yourself in unlimited quantities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ごはん{盛|も}り{放題|ほうだい}: unlimited rice servings
- ⟦サラダ→サラダ：01364_sarada⟧{盛|も}り{放題|ほうだい}: all-you-can-serve salad
- {盛|も}り{放題|ほうだい}⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧: unlimited serving service

RELATED 〜{放題|ほうだい} EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{食|た}べ{放題|ほうだい}→食べ放題：08291_tabehoudai⟧: all-you-can-eat
- ⟦{飲|の}み{放題|ほうだい}→飲み放題：08308_nomihoudai⟧: all-you-can-drink
- ⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦{放題|ほうだい}→放題：03151_houdai⟧: take as much as you want
- ⟦{言|い}いたい→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{放題|ほうだい}→放題：03151_houdai⟧: saying whatever one pleases
